patterns.usage_note: Names an organization or group as the one acting, not the place the action happens: 警察で調べる says the police are doing the investigating, and が can replace it (警察が調べる). Sibling で entries: place of an action (カフェで勉強する), means, material or cause (筆で書く, 風邪で休む), price or standard (半額で), copula linking form (休みで), te-form joint (呼んで). It takes nouns for bodies or groupings (会社, 委員会, 二人).

examples.ruby: その件[けん]は警察[けいさつ]で調[しら]べているそうだ。
examples.english: I hear the police are looking into that matter.

examples.ruby: 引[ひ]っ越[こ]しの費用[ひよう]は会社[かいしゃ]で負担[ふたん]してくれる。
examples.english: The company covers the moving expenses for us.

examples.ruby: 今年[ことし]の旅行[りょこう]の行[い]き先[さき]は家族[かぞく]で決[き]めた。
examples.english: We settled on this year's trip destination as a family.
